_comment: Tuning for the viability model. Dates are ISO. Weights are added to the day-of-week base; negatives are penalties.
_base_note: 0=Mon .. 6=Sun. Saturday leads because this circuit already books Saturdays: Atul Khatri, Gaurav Kapoor, Sumukhi Suresh, Kunal Kamra, Biswa Kalyan Rath and Varun Grover all play Sat.
_moon_note: Ramadan and Eid are astronomical forecasts and move with the moon sighting. Re-check each year and update these two windows; the model treats them as hard inputs.

peak_windows.label: Dubai Shopping Festival and winter peak: visitor numbers high

low_windows.label: Late-August low season: a large share of residents are still away

_scrape_note: Fail-loud thresholds for src/scrape.py, not used by the model. The 17 Aug 2026 sweep saw 67 events (64 Dubai, 3 Abu Dhabi), so min_events has little headroom once a festival wave rolls off; raise it only with evidence.
